steps.instructions: Inside the assigned output directory, make a disposable clone of {{cwd}} named work and check out {{base}} there. Work only in that clone. {{prompt}} When finished, from the root of work run `git add -A -- . && git diff --cached --binary --full-index --no-ext-diff --no-textconv {{base}} -- . > ../changes.diff`. Force-add any intended ignored deliverable before this step. After the patch succeeds, remove only the disposable clone. Reply with the patch filename.
